versos.grego: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ διὰ θελήματος Θεοῦ καὶ Τιμόθεος ὁ ἀδελφὸς

controles.web: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,
controles.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, and Timotheus our brother,
controles.livre: Paulo, apóstolo de Cristo Jesus pela vontade de Deus, e o irmão Timóteo,

versos.grego: τοῖς ἐν Κολοσσαῖς ἁγίοις καὶ πιστοῖς ἀδελφοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ· χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν.

controles.web: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: To the saints and faithful brethren in Christ which are at Colosse: Grace be unto you, and peace, from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
controles.livre: aos santos e fiéis irmãos em Cristo, que estão em Colossos. Haja em vós a graça e paz da parte de Deus nosso Pai.

versos.grego: Εὐχαριστοῦμεν τῷ Θεῷ Πατρὶ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν προσευχόμενοι,

controles.web: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
controles.kjv: We give thanks to God and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,
controles.livre: Agradecemos ao Deus e Pai do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, sempre orando por vós;

versos.grego: ἀκούσαντες τὴν πίστιν ὑμῶν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τὴν ἀγάπην ἣν ἔχετε εἰς πάντας τοὺς ἁγίους

controles.web: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which you have toward all the saints,
controles.kjv: Since we heard of your faith in Christ Jesus, and of the love which ye have to all the saints,
controles.livre: pois ouvimos falar da vossa fé em Cristo Jesus, e do amor que tendes para com todos os santos;

versos.grego: διὰ τὴν ἐλπίδα τὴν ἀποκειμένην ὑμῖν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς, ἣν προηκούσατε ἐν τῷ λόγῳ τῆς ἀληθείας τοῦ εὐαγγελίου

controles.web: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News,
controles.kjv: For the hope which is laid up for you in heaven, whereof ye heard before in the word of the truth of the gospel;
controles.livre: por causa da esperança que está reservada para vós nos céus. Anteriormente ouvistes dessa esperança  pala palavra da verdade do evangelho,

versos.grego: τοῦ παρόντος εἰς ὑμᾶς, καθὼς καὶ ἐν παντὶ τῷ κόσμῳ ἐστὶν καρποφορούμενον καὶ αὐξανόμενον καθὼς καὶ ἐν ὑμῖν, ἀφ’ ἧς ἡμέρας ἠκούσατε καὶ ἐπέγνωτε τὴν χάριν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν ἀληθείᾳ·

controles.web: which has come to you; even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth;
controles.kjv: Which is come unto you, as it is in all the world; and bringeth forth fruit, as it doth also in you, since the day ye heard of it, and knew the grace of God in truth:
controles.livre: que já chegou a vós, como também em todo o mundo; e vai frutificando e crescendo assim como entre vós, desde o dia em que ouvistes e conhecestes a graça de Deus em verdade.

versos.grego: καθὼς ἐμάθετε ἀπὸ Ἐπαφρᾶ τοῦ ἀγαπητοῦ συνδούλου ἡμῶν, ὅς ἐστιν πιστὸς ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν διάκονος τοῦ Χριστοῦ,

controles.web: even as you learned of Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on our behalf,
controles.kjv: As ye also learned of Epaphras our dear fellowservant, who is for you a faithful minister of Christ;
controles.livre: Aprendestes o evangelho  por Epafras, nosso amado cooperador, que é um fiel servidor de Cristo em vosso favor.

versos.grego: ὁ καὶ δηλώσας ἡμῖν τὴν ὑμῶν ἀγάπην ἐν Πνεύματι.

controles.web: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.
controles.kjv: Who also declared unto us your love in the Spirit.
controles.livre: Ele também nos declarou o vosso amor no Espírito.

versos.grego: Διὰ τοῦτο καὶ ἡμεῖς, ἀφ’ ἧς ἡμέρας ἠκούσαμεν, οὐ παυόμεθα ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν προσευχόμενοι καὶ αἰτούμενοι ἵνα πληρωθῆτε τὴν ἐπίγνωσιν τοῦ θελήματος αὐτοῦ ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ καὶ συνέσει πνευματικῇ,

controles.web: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
controles.kjv: For this cause we also, since the day we heard it, do not cease to pray for you, and to desire that ye might be filled with the knowledge of his will in all wisdom and spiritual understanding;
controles.livre: Por isso também, desde o dia que o ouvimos, não paramos de orar por vós, e de pedir que sejais cheios do conhecimento da sua vontade, em toda sabedoria e entendimento espiritual;

versos.grego: περιπατῆσαι ἀξίως τοῦ Κυρίου εἰς πᾶσαν ἀρεσκείαν, ἐν παντὶ ἔργῳ ἀγαθῷ καρποφοροῦντες καὶ αὐξανόμενοι τῇ ἐπιγνώσει τοῦ Θεοῦ,

controles.web: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
controles.kjv: That ye might walk worthy of the Lord unto all pleasing, being fruitful in every good work, and increasing in the knowledge of God;
controles.livre: para que possais andar dignamente diante do Senhor, agradando-lhe em tudo, frutificando em toda boa obra, e crescendo no conhecimento de Deus;

versos.grego: ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει δυναμούμενοι κατὰ τὸ κράτος τῆς δόξης αὐτοῦ εἰς πᾶσαν ὑπομονὴν καὶ μακροθυμίαν, μετὰ χαρᾶς

controles.web: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy;
controles.kjv: Strengthened with all might, according to his glorious power, unto all patience and longsuffering with joyfulness;
controles.livre: capacitados em todo fortalecimento, segundo o poder da sua glória, em toda perseverança e paciência com alegria,

versos.grego: εὐχαριστοῦντες τῷ Πατρὶ τῷ ἱκανώσαντι ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν μερίδα τοῦ κλήρου τῶν ἁγίων ἐν τῷ φωτί·

controles.web: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light;
controles.kjv: Giving thanks unto the Father, which hath made us meet to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light:
controles.livre: agradecendo ao Pai, que vos capacitou a participar da herança dos santos na luz.

versos.grego: ὃς ἐρύσατο ἡμᾶς ἐκ τῆς ἐξουσίας τοῦ σκότους καὶ μετέστησεν εἰς τὴν βασιλείαν τοῦ Υἱοῦ τῆς ἀγάπης αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love;
controles.kjv: Who hath delivered us from the power of darkness, and hath translated us into the kingdom of his dear Son:
controles.livre: Ele nos tirou do domínio das trevas, e nos transportou para o reino do seu amado Filho,

versos.grego: ἐν ᾧ ἔχομεν τὴν ἀπολύτρωσιν, τὴν ἄφεσιν τῶν ἁμαρτιῶν·

controles.web: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins;
controles.kjv: In whom we have redemption through his blood, even the forgiveness of sins:
controles.livre: em quem temos a libertação:  o perdão dos pecados.

versos.grego: ὅς ἐστιν εἰκὼν τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ ἀοράτου, πρωτότοκος πάσης κτίσεως,

controles.web: who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.
controles.kjv: Who is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of every creature:
controles.livre: Ele é a imagem do Deus invisível, o primogênito de toda a criação;

versos.grego: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ ἐκτίσθη τὰ πάντα ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, τὰ ὁρατὰ καὶ τὰ ἀόρατα, εἴτε θρόνοι εἴτε κυριότητες εἴτε ἀρχαὶ εἴτε ἐξουσίαι· τὰ πάντα δι’ αὐτοῦ καὶ εἰς αὐτὸν ἔκτισται·

controles.web: For by him all things were created, in the heavens and on the earth, things visible and things invisible, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers; all things have been created through him, and for him.
controles.kjv: For by him were all things created, that are in heaven, and that are in earth, visible and invisible, whether they be thrones, or dominions, or principalities, or powers: all things were created by him, and for him:
controles.livre: porque nele foram criadas todas as coisas que há nos céus e na terra, visíveis e invisíveis, sejam tronos, sejam domínios, sejam governos, sejam autoridades; todas as coisas foram criadas por ele e para ele.

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτός ἐστιν πρὸ πάντων καὶ τὰ πάντα ἐν αὐτῷ συνέστηκεν,

controles.web: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.
controles.kjv: And he is before all things, and by him all things consist.
controles.livre: Ele existe antes de todas as coisas, e nele todas as coisas se mantêm.

versos.grego: καὶ αὐτός ἐστιν ἡ κεφαλὴ τοῦ σώματος, τῆς ἐκκλησίας· ὅς ἐστιν ἀρχή, πρωτότοκος ἐκ τῶν νεκρῶν, ἵνα γένηται ἐν πᾶσιν αὐτὸς πρωτεύων,

controles.web: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
controles.kjv: And he is the head of the body, the church: who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead; that in all things he might have the preeminence.
controles.livre: E ele é a cabeça do corpo, da Igreja; ele é o princípio e o primogênito dentre os mortos, para que tenha a primazia entre todos.

versos.grego: ὅτι ἐν αὐτῷ εὐδόκησεν πᾶν τὸ πλήρωμα κατοικῆσαι

controles.web: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him;
controles.kjv: For it pleased the Father that in him should all fulness dwell;
controles.livre: Pois foi do agrado do Pai que toda a plenitude habitasse nele;

versos.grego: καὶ δι’ αὐτοῦ ἀποκαταλλάξαι τὰ πάντα εἰς αὐτόν, εἰρηνοποιήσας διὰ τοῦ αἵματος τοῦ σταυροῦ αὐτοῦ, δι’ αὐτοῦ εἴτε τὰ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς εἴτε τὰ ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς.

controles.web: and through him to reconcile all things to himself, by him, whether things on the earth, or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.
controles.kjv: And, having made peace through the blood of his cross, by him to reconcile all things unto himself; by him, I say, whether they be things in earth, or things in heaven.
controles.livre: e, havendo por ele feito a paz pelo sangue da sua cruz, por meio dele reconciliasse consigo mesmo todas as coisas, tanto as que estão na terra, como as que estão nos céus.

versos.grego: καὶ ὑμᾶς ποτε ὄντας ἀπηλλοτριωμένους καὶ ἐχθροὺς τῇ διανοίᾳ ἐν τοῖς ἔργοις τοῖς πονηροῖς,

controles.web: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil works,
controles.kjv: And you, that were sometime alienated and enemies in your mind by wicked works, yet now hath he reconciled
controles.livre: Vós éreis separados dele , e inimigos no entendimento, em más obras. Porém agora ele vos reconciliou,

versos.grego: νυνὶ δὲ ἀποκατήλλαξεν ἐν τῷ σώματι τῆς σαρκὸς αὐτοῦ διὰ τοῦ θανάτου, παραστῆσαι ὑμᾶς ἁγίους καὶ ἀμώμους καὶ ἀνεγκλήτους κατενώπιον αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,
controles.kjv: In the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and unblameable and unreproveable in his sight:
controles.livre: no seu corpo de carne, pela morte, para vos apresentar diante dele santos, irrepreensíveis e inculpáveis;

versos.grego: εἴ γε ἐπιμένετε τῇ πίστει τεθεμελιωμένοι καὶ ἑδραῖοι καὶ μὴ μετακινούμενοι ἀπὸ τῆς ἐλπίδος τοῦ εὐαγγελίου οὗ ἠκούσατε, τοῦ κηρυχθέντος ἐν πάσῃ κτίσει τῇ ὑπὸ τὸν οὐρανόν, οὗ ἐγενόμην ἐγὼ Παῦλος διάκονος.

controles.web: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which is being proclaimed in all creation under heaven; of which I, Paul, was made a servant.
controles.kjv: If ye continue in the faith grounded and settled, and be not moved away from the hope of the gospel, which ye have heard, and which was preached to every creature which is under heaven; whereof I Paul am made a minister;
controles.livre: se, de fato, permaneceis fundados e firmes na fé, e não vos afastais da esperança do evangelho que ouvistes, que é pregado a toda criatura que há abaixo do céu, e do qual eu, Paulo, fui feito servidor.

versos.grego: Νῦν χαίρω ἐν τοῖς παθήμασιν ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν, καὶ ἀνταναπληρῶ τὰ ὑστερήματα τῶν θλίψεων τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐν τῇ σαρκί μου ὑπὲρ τοῦ σώματος αὐτοῦ, ὅ ἐστιν ἡ ἐκκλησία,

controles.web: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly;
controles.kjv: Who now rejoice in my sufferings for you, and fill up that which is behind of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the church:
controles.livre: Agora me alegro nos meus sofrimentos por vós, e cumpro na minha carne o restante das aflições de Cristo, em benefício do seu corpo, que é a Igreja.

versos.grego: ἧς ἐγενόμην ἐγὼ διάκονος κατὰ τὴν οἰκονομίαν τοῦ Θεοῦ τὴν δοθεῖσάν μοι εἰς ὑμᾶς πληρῶσαι τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ,

controles.web: of which I was made a servant, according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you, to fulfill the word of God,
controles.kjv: Whereof I am made a minister, according to the dispensation of God which is given to me for you, to fulfil the word of God;
controles.livre: Dela eu fui feito servidor segundo a responsabilidade da parte de Deus que me foi dada para o vosso benefício, a fim de cumprir a palavra de Deus,

versos.grego: τὸ μυστήριον τὸ ἀποκεκρυμμένον ἀπὸ τῶν αἰώνων καὶ ἀπὸ τῶν γενεῶν— νῦν δὲ ἐφανερώθη τοῖς ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ,

controles.web: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,
controles.kjv: Even the mystery which hath been hid from ages and from generations, but now is made manifest to his saints:
controles.livre: o mistério que estava oculto desde os princípios dos tempos e das gerações; mas agora foi manifesto aos seus santos.

versos.grego: οἷς ἠθέλησεν ὁ Θεὸς γνωρίσαι τί τὸ πλοῦτος τῆς δόξης τοῦ μυστηρίου τούτου ἐν τοῖς ἔθνεσιν, ὅς ἐστιν Χριστὸς ἐν ὑμῖν, ἡ ἐλπὶς τῆς δόξης·

controles.web: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory;
controles.kjv: To whom God would make known what is the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles; which is Christ in you, the hope of glory:
controles.livre: A eles Deus quis fazer que conhecessem as riquezas da glória deste mistério entre os gentios, que é Cristo em vós, a esperança da glória.

versos.grego: ὃν ἡμεῖς καταγγέλλομεν νουθετοῦντες πάντα ἄνθρωπον καὶ διδάσκοντες πάντα ἄνθρωπον ἐν πάσῃ σοφίᾳ, ἵνα παραστήσωμεν πάντα ἄνθρωπον τέλειον ἐν Χριστῷ·

controles.web: whom we proclaim, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;
controles.kjv: Whom we preach, warning every man, and teaching every man in all wisdom; that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus:
controles.livre: Ele é quem anunciamos, advertindo a toda pessoa, e ensinando a toda pessoa, com toda sabedoria; a fim de que apresentemos toda pessoa como completa em Cristo.

versos.grego: εἰς ὃ καὶ κοπιῶ ἀγωνιζόμενος κατὰ τὴν ἐνέργειαν αὐτοῦ τὴν ἐνεργουμένην ἐν ἐμοὶ ἐν δυνάμει.

controles.web: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.
controles.kjv: Whereunto I also labour, striving according to his working, which worketh in me mightily.
controles.livre: Para isso eu também trabalho, lutando conforme a eficácia dele, que age em mim com poder.
